scenes.summary: Li Wei, now a mocked junior disciple, endures public humiliation from Senior Disciple Zhao and other peers in the bustling training grounds, highlighting his current powerlessness and the simmering rage beneath his humble exterior.

character_wardrobe_notes.wardrobe: Traditional white and blue robes, long dark hair, appears humble.
Sect disciple robes, well-maintained and conveying status.

must_keep_scene_facts: Li Wei is outwardly perceived as a weak junior disciple.
Li Wei harbors a hidden, ancient power and burning rage for vengeance.

environment_notes: A bustling, open-air training area within an ancient China-inspired cultivation sect, featuring traditional grand architecture, stone sparring platforms, and practice dummies.

identity_notes: A former supreme Heavenly Emperor, now a weak, mocked junior disciple in an ancient China-inspired cultivation world. Possesses a depth of ancient power and a burning desire for retribution.
wardrobe_notes: Traditional white and blue clothing, long dark hair.

identity_notes: An arrogant senior disciple of the sect, representing the current power structure in an ancient China-inspired cultivation world, completely unaware of Li Wei's true identity.

global_style_notes: Overall style is martial arts fantasy, inspired by ancient China, focusing on themes of rebirth, revenge, and being underestimated.

scene_end.turn: Li Wei's silent endurance of mockery solidifies his resolve for vengeance.
scene_end.emotional_shift: From public humiliation to internal, burning determination.

shots.text: The Azure Cloud Sect Training Grounds buzzes with activity. Junior disciples spar on stone platforms; some practice forms with dummies. On the edge, LI WEI (17, char_001), slender and unassuming in simple robes, attempts basic sword forms with a practice sword, visibly struggling.

camera.framing_notes: Emphasize the bustling environment and Li Wei's peripheral presence.

shots.visual_goal: Establish the bustling, competitive environment and Li Wei's current lowly, struggling status.
shots.action_focus: The contrast between the active training grounds and Li Wei's perceived weakness.

shots.text: SENIOR DISCIPLE ZHAO (char_002), confident and well-built, struts past Li Wei with a sneer. He stops, watching Li Wei's clumsy movements with contempt, before addressing him mockingly.

camera.framing_notes: Focus on the interaction between Zhao and Li Wei.

shots.visual_goal: Introduce Senior Disciple Zhao and his dismissive attitude towards Li Wei.
shots.action_focus: Zhao's arrogant demeanor and Li Wei's reaction to his presence.

shots.text: Still fumbling with basic forms, Li Wei? Perhaps you should stick to sweeping floors. Some talents are simply... not meant for cultivation.

camera.framing_notes: Tight on Zhao's face to capture his condescension.

shots.visual_goal: Emphasize Zhao's condescending tone and Li Wei's forced reaction.
shots.action_focus: Zhao's face as he delivers the insult.

shots.text: Li Wei's face remains passive, but a fleeting, ancient coldness flashes deep within his eyes, unnoticed by Zhao. He simply bows his head slightly, gripping his practice sword tighter.

camera.framing_notes: Tight on Li Wei's eyes to convey hidden power and resolve.

shots.visual_goal: Reveal Li Wei's hidden resolve and suppressed power, hinting at his true identity.
shots.action_focus: The subtle but powerful expression in Li Wei's eyes.

scenes.summary: Alone in his humble room, Li Wei attempts to secretly cultivate, battling the limitations of his new body while drawing strength from memories of his past as the Heavenly Emperor.

character_wardrobe_notes.wardrobe: Simple, worn inner robes suitable for sleep or meditation.

must_keep_scene_facts: Li Wei is secretly attempting cultivation to regain his past power.
His dwelling is sparse, reflecting his low status.

environment_notes: A small, sparsely furnished room within the junior disciple quarters, emphasizing Li Wei's current lowly status in this ancient China-inspired cultivation world. Contains a simple bed and low table.

identity_notes: A former supreme Heavenly Emperor, now a weak, mocked junior disciple in an ancient China-inspired cultivation world. Possesses a depth of ancient power and a burning desire for retribution.
wardrobe_notes: Traditional white and blue clothing, long dark hair.

global_style_notes: Overall style is martial arts fantasy, inspired by ancient China, focusing on themes of rebirth, revenge, and being underestimated.

scene_end.turn: Li Wei successfully draws a small, visible wisp of spiritual energy into his dantian, confirming that his cultivation path is viable and his return to power has begun.
scene_end.emotional_shift: From frustration and remembered betrayal to renewed hope and fierce determination.

shots.text: Inside his sparsely furnished dwelling, illuminated only by a flickering OIL LAMP (prop_002), Li Wei sits cross-legged on a thin mat, eyes closed in deep meditation. His posture is rigid, betraying immense effort.

camera.framing_notes: Highlight the solitude and focus of Li Wei.

shots.visual_goal: Establish Li Wei's humble, solitary environment and his deep concentration.
shots.action_focus: Li Wei's meditative posture and the starkness of his room.

shots.text: Sweat beads on Li Wei's brow. His expression is strained, fragmented images of a majestic throne and colossal betrayers flash in his mind's eye. He pushes harder, a faint spiritual pressure growing around him.

camera.framing_notes: Emphasize Li Wei's struggle and internal conflict.

shots.visual_goal: Show Li Wei's internal struggle and the immense difficulty of his cultivation.
shots.action_focus: Li Wei's intense facial expression and the subtle manifestations of spiritual energy.

shots.text: A tiny, visible wisp of pure spiritual energy coalesces around Li Wei's fingertips, then gently sinks into his chest. His eyes snap open, burning with a mix of surprise and fierce satisfaction. The cultivation has begun.

camera.framing_notes: Highlight the spiritual energy and Li Wei's reaction.

shots.visual_goal: Confirm Li Wei's success in channeling spiritual energy and signify the turning point of his journey.
shots.action_focus: The wisp of energy and Li Wei's triumphant gaze.

scenes.summary: Back in the training grounds, Li Wei subtly performs a minor cultivation feat by reviving a withered plant, unnoticed by the oblivious Senior Disciple Zhao, solidifying Li Wei's silent path of vengeance.

character_wardrobe_notes.wardrobe: Traditional white and blue robes, now worn with a subtle air of newfound confidence.
Sect disciple robes, same as before, conveying his unchanging arrogance.

must_keep_scene_facts: Li Wei's cultivation is progressing, but he maintains his weak facade.
Senior Disciple Zhao remains oblivious to Li Wei's true power and intent.

environment_notes: A bustling, open-air training area within an ancient China-inspired cultivation sect, featuring traditional grand architecture, stone sparring platforms, and practice dummies.

identity_notes: A former supreme Heavenly Emperor, now a weak, mocked junior disciple in an ancient China-inspired cultivation world. Possesses a depth of ancient power and a burning desire for retribution.
wardrobe_notes: Traditional white and blue clothing, long dark hair.

identity_notes: An arrogant senior disciple of the sect, representing the current power structure in an ancient China-inspired cultivation world, completely unaware of Li Wei's true identity.

global_style_notes: Overall style is martial arts fantasy, inspired by ancient China, focusing on themes of rebirth, revenge, and being underestimated.

scene_end.turn: Senior Disciple Zhao dismisses Li Wei with a glance, sealing his own fate as Li Wei's intent for revenge is fully crystallized.
scene_end.emotional_shift: From concealed potential to cold, resolute vengeance.

shots.text: Among the bustling training grounds, Li Wei stands near a section of overgrown weeds and a WITHERED PLANT (prop_003). He subtly extends a hand, a barely perceptible shimmer of spiritual energy flowing from his palm towards the plant.

camera.framing_notes: Focus on Li Wei's hand and the subtle energy transfer.

shots.visual_goal: Show Li Wei practicing his nascent abilities discreetly.
shots.action_focus: Li Wei's focused hand and the subtle energy display.

shots.text: The WITHERED PLANT (prop_003) visibly perks up, its leaves regaining a vibrant green in a matter of seconds. Simultaneously, SENIOR DISCIPLE ZHAO (char_002) walks by, engrossed in conversation with other disciples, completely missing the miracle beside him.

camera.framing_notes: Capture both the plant's revival and Zhao's unobservant passing.

shots.visual_goal: Highlight Zhao's obliviousness to Li Wei's growing power.
shots.action_focus: The revived plant and Zhao's unobservant passing.

shots.text: Zhao glances briefly at Li Wei, a familiar look of dismissal on his face, before turning his attention back to his companions and laughing loudly. He doesn't even register the now healthy plant.
shots.visual_goal: Reinforce Zhao's contempt and Li Wei's 'unseen' threat.
shots.action_focus: Zhao's dismissive glance and subsequent ignorance.

shots.text: Li Wei watches Zhao walk away, a faint, chilling smile playing on his lips. His eyes, now undeniably ancient and formidable, promise devastation. The Heavenly Emperor's revenge has officially begun, unnoticed by those he will destroy.

camera.framing_notes: Tight on Li Wei's face, highlighting his eyes and vengeful expression.

shots.visual_goal: Conclude the scene with a clear statement of Li Wei's intent and the audience's knowledge of the impending doom.
shots.action_focus: Li Wei's face, specifically his eyes and subtle, vengeful smile.
